Hello friends,

This week: why I stopped refreshing, three essays worth your evening, and a recipe for slow bread.

1. Stop refreshing

The best interface to the news is a printed page that arrives once a day. I tried it for a month.

2. Three essays

  • On boredom
  • On maps
  • On waiting

Until next week,
Dana
